translation.name: Kameethari Ñaantsi: ikenkitha-takoitziri awinkatharite Jesucristo; Owakerari aapatziya-wakagaantsi

content: Jesús ikiwayitzitziri riyotaanewopaini

Yotapaaka apaani kiteesheri roimoshirenkantaityaawori Anonkoryagaantsi. Riyotake Jesús monkaatzimatapaaka rookanawentantyaawori kipatsi, riyaatai intsipatapaiyaari Ipaapate. Antawoite retakoyetakari ikaatzi kemisantakeriri, ari ikantapiintatya retakotari irojatzi weyaantapaakyaawone.
Ikanta risaiki rowaiyani, kamaarishiretanake Judas Iscariote, itomi Simón, pithokashityaarine Jesús.
Riyotake Jesús tema ipoñaatyaawo irirori Pawaki, ari riyaateri janta. Iriitake shintsitakaakeriri Ipaapate.
Ari ikatziyanaka risaikakera rowaiyani, raatonkoryaanakawo iwewiryaakowo, romathakitanakawo manthakintsi.
Raake ñaa risakero kiwaakomentotsiki. Ikiwayitzitakeri riyotaanewo, rosheyitzitantzimaitari manthakintsi romathakitakari.
Iro inkiwayitzitantyaaririme Simón Pedro, ikantanake irirori: “Pinkatharí, ¿eerokama kiwayitzitenane naaka?”
Ikantzi Jesús: “Te pikemathatziro okaatzi nantziri iroñaaka, iro kantacha paata, ari pinkemathatairo.”
Ikantanake Pedro: “¡Eero nishinetzimaitzimi poshiyaari imperataarewo pinkiwayitzitena!” Rakanake Jesús: “Eerorika nokiwayitzitzimi, te paapatziyana.”
Ikantzi Simón Pedro: “¡Pinkatharí, eero pikiwayitzitana eepichokiini, maawoini pinkiwena nakoki eejatzi noitoki!”
Ikantzi Jesús: “Ikaatzi eshitakerone ikaawoshita, apatziro ikowi inkiwayitzitya, tema kitetake maawoini. Ari kitetakemi eerokapaini, okantawetaka te maawoini pinkiteshiretaiyeni.”
Tema riyotakeri Jesús iita pithokashityaarine, iro ikantantari: “Te maawoini pinkiteshirete.”
Ari rithonkakero ikiwayitzitakerira, ikithaatanaawo Jesús iwewiryaakowo, saikanai tsika rowaiyani, ari ikantzi: “¿Pikemathatakeroma okaatzi nantakeri?
Pikantapiintaiyini eerokapaini ‘Yotaanarí, Pinkatharí.’ Imatatya pikantanari, tema naakatake.
Naaka ‘Yotaantaneri’, naaka ‘Pinkathari.’ Iro kantacha, noshiyakotari imperataarewo, nokiwayitzitakemi, ari pinkantaiyaari eerokapaini pinkiwayitzitawakagaiya.
Naaka yotaakemirori, poshiyakotenawo tsika nokantakemi naaka.
Te ipinkathaitziri noshikaarewo ranairi imperatariri. Tekaatsi eejatzi otyaantaarewo anairine otyaantziriri. Imaperotatya.
Arika pinkemathatanairo jiroka irojatzi pantantaiyaawori, aritake pinkimoshiretai.
Pinkeme nonkantemi, iro kantacha te maawoini niñaanatemi. Niyotziri naaka ikaatzi niyoshiitakeri. Arira imonkaatyaari Osankenarentsipero, kantatsiri:
Arika imonkaatakya jiroka, iroowa pinkemisantaperotantenari ‘Naakatzitaka.’ Iro neewatantzimirori nokamantzimiro.
Inkaate kempiyaarine notyaantanewo, naakatake ikempiyaminthata. Inkaate kempiyenane naaka, ikempiyaminthatari otyaantakenari.”
Ithawetzi Jesús ripithokashityaari Judas

Ikaatapaakero riñaawaitakero jiroka, antawoite okatsitzimoshiretanakeri Jesús. Eekero rooñaawontanakitziiro ikenkithatakotakeri, ikantzi: “Pikaatakera eerokapaini jaka, eenitatsi apaani pithokashitenane. Imaperotatya.”
Ari raminawakaanaka riyotaanewo, te riyotzi itzimi ikantziri.
Ikanta apaani riyotaanewo, retakoperotanewo Jesús, shentakeriri okaakiini rowaiyani,
riñaanacheratakeri Simón Pedro, ikantziri: “Posampiteri itzimirika ikantziri.”
Ikanta jirika shentakeriri okaakiini, rosampitakeri: “Pinkatharí, ¿Itzimika?”
Rakanake Jesús: “Piñeena nashete eepichokiini pan, itzimirika nompakeri, iriitakera.” Rashetake eepichokiini pan, ipakeri Judas Iscariote, itomi Simón.
Ikanta rowawakawo Judas pan. Kamaaritanake. Ikantziri Jesús: “Thaakyaapaini pantero pikenkithashiretapiintakari.”
Ikaatzira rowaiyani tekaatsi kemathatawakerone oita ikantantariri.
Tema jirika Judas iriitake kempoyiiriri koriki, roshiyakagaitzi riyaatatye ramanante roimoshirenkyaari ikantakeriri Jesús, roshiyakagaitzi eejatzi ramanantatye imperiri ashironkainkaripaini.
Ikaatakero Judas rowakawo pan, jatanake. Tema tsirenitanake.
Owakerari Inintakaantaitanewo
Jatake Judas, ikantzi Jesús: “Monkaatapaaka rowenonkashitantaiyaawori rowaneenkawo Itomi Atziri. Ari iñagaitairo rowaneenkawo Pawa.
Ari okanta, iriitake Pawa oñaaganterone iñagaitantyaawori rowaneenkawo. Iroñaakaga rantero.

Notomipaini, eepichokiini nisaikimotanaimi. Osheki pithotyaakowetaina eerokapaini, eeromaita piñagaana. Iro nokantzitakariri eejatzi asheninkapaini Judá-ite, iroowa napiitemiri nonkantemiro eerokapaini, eero pitsipatana tsika nisaikapai naaka.
Jiroka owakerari nonintakaantanewo: ‘Ontzimatye petakotawakagaiya.’ Poshiyena naaka netakotzimi, ari pinkantyaari eerokapaini, petakotawakagaiya.
Arika petakotawakaanaiya eerokapaini, ari riyoitaimi maawoini eerokatake niyotaanewo.”
Ikenkithatakotziro Jesús rookanawentante Pedro
Ikanta Simón Pedro rosampitanakeri Jesús: “Pinkatharí, ¿tsika piyaateka?” Rakanake Jesús, ikantzi: “Tsikarika niyaate naaka, eerowa pimatziro poyaatena eerokapaini, irooma paata aritake poyaatakena.”
Ikantanake Pedro: “Pinkatharí, ¿iitaka eero noyaatantzimi iroñaaka? ¡Arira nishinewentakemi!”
Rakanakeri Jesús, ikantziri: “¿Imaperotatya pishinewentena? Tekera riñeeta tyaapa, mawa papiitero pinkante: ‘Te niyotziri Jesús.’ Imaperotatya.”

footnotes.text: Iro rametari Judá-ite ikiwayitzitapiinta inkyaantyaari ipankoki. Iroowa rantawaire apaani imperataarewo ikiwayitzitantapiintzi. Apaani iriiperori atziri, eero okanta inkiwayitzitante. Iro kaari inimotantariri pairani riyotaanewo Jesús ikiwayitzitakerira. Iro rantantakawori jiroka Jesús, riyotaatziiri riyotaanewo, onkantawetya jewari rine apaani atziri, ontzimatye raapatziyaari itsipa, roshiyakotyaari ikanta apaani imperataarewo, tsinampashireri inkantya.
Raakotapiintaka Jesús ikantzi “Naakatzitaka”, ari oshiyawo riñaawaitake Pawa pairani. Paminero Jn. 8.58.
Kantakotachari jaka “Kamaaritanake”, te iro pan kantakaanterone rowawakawowa ikamaaritantanakari Judas, iriitakera kantakaashitakawo ikamaaritantanakari.
